description: Default spoken voices per timbre, the narrator and tones per face (moods) for --speech tts renders (SPEECH_SPEC 5). Read by tools/lib/tts, never by the engine. Models are Piper voices in assets/speech/models/ (see assets/speech/VOICES.md for licenses).

soft.description: A warm, gentle voice for heroes and friends; pitch follows the cast's voice.pitch, gently.

squeaky.description: A bright, high voice for little buddies and kids: a female voice shifted up.

deep.description: A low male voice for big characters, elders and villains: john shifted down (norman garbles short sentences).

robot.description: A male voice made buzzy and metallic with a ring-modulation filter.

bark.description: A dog: always keeps its babble woofs, even in tts renders.

narrator.description: The storyteller who reads narration boxes: a calm, clear British voice.

neutral.description: Plain speech: the character's own voice, no tone change.

happy.description: Bright and bouncy: a little faster, higher and livelier.

laugh.description: Giggly: faster and higher, with a light bubbly wobble.

love.description: Warm and soft: a touch slower and gentler.

surprised.description: Excited or amazed: quick, high and loud.

determined.description: Firm and sure: steady pace, a little louder, less wobble.

smug.description: Sly and pleased: slower, lower, with knowing pauses.

sad.description: Sad: slow, lower and quieter, with long pauses and a dull tone.

cry.description: Tearful: slow and shaky, the voice trembles.

angry.description: Cross: a bit faster, lower and louder.

furious.description: Very angry: fast, low and loud.

scared.description: Frightened: very fast, high and quiet, with a nervous shake.

tired.description: Sleepy: slow, low and quiet, with long pauses.

dizzy.description: Woozy: slower, with a slow wobbly pitch.

hurt.description: In pain (cartoon 'ow'): strained and shaky, a little higher.

asleep.description: Talking in sleep: very slow, low and quiet.
